### 📱 What is the name/purpose of this screen/feature?
*Write your text idea here (e.g., "A login screen" or "An AI text generator page")*

### 🛠️ Required Package Checkboxes
- [ ] **Main Layout File:** Have I created the visual layout for *this specific page*?
- [ ] **Logic/Brain File:** Is there a background file telling this page what to do?
- [ ] **Navigation/Routing:** Have I linked this page to the home page or previous pages?
- [ ] **Internet/API Connection:** If this page talks to the internet or an AI, did I include the connection tokens *on this specific page*?
- [ ] **Assets:** Are the icons, images, or fonts for this page placed in the correct folder?

### 🤖 Prompt for your Free AI (ChatGPT/Claude):
> "I am building a feature for my app. Here is my idea: [PASTE YOUR IDEA HERE]. Based on the checklist above, please give me the exact file names and structure I need to create in my GitHub repository so I don't miss any connected pages."
